name: troubleshoot-host-startup-failure
prompt: A .NET 10 WPF application using Generic Host exits during startup after a hosted service throws. Diagnose ownership, logging, degraded-mode, and shutdown behavior.
rubric: Identifies startup ordering, exception propagation, and application lifetime ownership.
Distinguishes a fatal dependency from a recoverable degraded-mode condition.
Provides structured logging, bounded startup, cancellation, and clean disposal validation.
